title: Assemble a clean fixture
question: What support does the Pro plan include?
description: Instructions, the user's plan, three support-plan chunks, one memory, two prior turns and the query, all admitted. The memory producer reports an expired memory without its body, and that row reaches the trace unchanged.
proves: Placement order, rendering, per-item token counts, the payload hash and the snapshot digest. Four assemblers produce the same bytes.
